billing.question: How does billing work?
billing.answer: Paid plans are billed through PayPal on a monthly or yearly cycle. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel from Studio → Subscription. Invoices and payment status sync via PayPal webhooks.

trial.question: Is there a free trial?
trial.answer: The Free plan includes a trial period with full Studio access. When the trial ends, your workspace keeps running on Free plan limits unless you subscribe to a paid tier.

tokens.question: What counts toward token usage?
tokens.answer: Token usage includes LLM input and output for chat, knowledge Q&A, and action selection across all projects in your workspace. Limits reset monthly per your plan.

upgrade.question: Can I change plans later?
upgrade.answer: Yes. Upgrade anytime from Studio — new limits apply immediately. Downgrades take effect at the end of the current billing period.

enterprise.question: Need more than Business?
enterprise.answer: Contact us for custom limits, dedicated support, and enterprise agreements.

docs.title: Documentation
docs.subtitle: Everything you need to integrate ActoCore into your application.

install.title: 1. Install the SDK
install.body: Add the React SDK to your app. Peer dependency: React 18 or 19.

styles.title: Import styles
styles.body: Import the SDK stylesheet once in your app entry or root layout.

credentials.title: 2. Get API credentials
credentials.body: In Studio, open your project → API keys. Create a key and copy it immediately — it is shown only once. Set environment variables in your host app.

embed.title: 3. Mount the chat widget
embed.body: Wrap your app with ActocoreProvider and add ActoChatWidget for a floating launcher. Use ActoChat for inline chat without the bubble.

studio.title: 4. Configure in Studio
studio.body: Before going live: create a project, upload knowledge documents for RAG, define actions your assistant can run, and tune SDK theme and copy under Project → SDK config.
bullets: Knowledge — upload PDFs, markdown, or text for grounded answers with citations
Actions — map natural-language intents to handlers in your app
SDK config — remote theme, locale, and security settings via loadRemoteConfig

next.title: 5. Next steps
next.body: Pin SDK versions in production. Enable loadRemoteConfig to let product teams update copy and theme without redeploying your app.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This privacy policy describes how ActoCore (“we”, “us”) collects and uses information when you use our website and products.

collect.title: Information we collect
collect.body: We collect account information you provide (such as name and email), usage data related to API and chat requests, and technical logs needed to operate the service.

use.title: How we use information
use.body: We use data to provide and improve ActoCore, secure the platform, process billing, and communicate about your account.

share.title: Sharing
share.body: We do not sell personal data. We share information with subprocessors only as needed to deliver the service.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.body: We retain account and usage data while your subscription is active and for a reasonable period afterward for legal, billing, and security purposes. You may request deletion of personal data subject to applicable law.

cookies.title: Cookies and analytics
cookies.body: Studio uses essential cookies for authentication and session management. We do not use third-party advertising cookies on our products. Marketing site analytics, if enabled, use aggregated usage data only.

subprocessors.title: Subprocessors
subprocessors.body: We rely on infrastructure and service providers including cloud hosting, MongoDB Atlas, email delivery (Resend), payment processing (PayPal), and LLM providers (such as Google Gemini) to operate ActoCore. Each processes data under contractual obligations.

transfers.title: International transfers
transfers.body: Data may be processed in the United States and other countries where our providers operate. We use appropriate safeguards for cross-border transfers where required.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or export personal data, and to object to or restrict certain processing. Contact privacy@actocore.pro to exercise these rights.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For privacy questions, contact us at privacy@actocore.pro.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using ActoCore, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service.

service.title: The service
service.body: ActoCore provides an AI integration platform including Studio, APIs, and an embeddable SDK. Features and limits depend on your subscription plan.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.body: You are responsible for safeguarding credentials and for activity under your workspace. You must provide accurate registration information.

acceptable.title: Acceptable use
acceptable.body: You may not misuse the service, attempt unauthorized access, or use ActoCore in violation of applicable law or third-party rights.

billing.title: Subscriptions and billing
billing.body: Paid plans renew automatically on the billing cycle you select (monthly or yearly) until cancelled. Prices are listed on our pricing page and in Studio. Payment is processed by PayPal.

cancellation.title: Cancellation and refunds
cancellation.body: You may cancel from Studio → Subscription. Cancellation stops future charges; access continues until the end of the paid period. Refunds are handled per PayPal policy and applicable law.

availability.title: Service availability
availability.body: We strive for high availability but do not guarantee uninterrupted service. Planned maintenance and third-party outages may affect access. SLA terms for eligible plans are described in your agreement.

ip.title: Intellectual property
ip.body: ActoCore retains rights in the platform, SDK, and documentation. You retain rights in your content, knowledge uploads, and application code. You grant us a license to process your content to provide the service.

termination.title: Termination
termination.body: We may suspend or terminate accounts for breach of these terms, non-payment, or abuse. You may close your account at any time. Provisions that by nature should survive termination will remain in effect.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.body: ActoCore is provided as-is to the extent permitted by law. Our liability is limited as described in your commercial agreement or standard SaaS terms.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For questions about these terms, contact legal@actocore.pro.

security.title: Security
security.intro: ActoCore is built for multi-tenant SaaS products. This page summarizes our security practices for customers evaluating the platform.

isolation.title: Tenant isolation
isolation.body: Each workspace, project, and knowledge corpus is scoped to your account. API keys are project-scoped. Cross-tenant data access is prevented at the application and database layer.

encryption.title: Encryption
encryption.body: Data in transit uses TLS. API keys and sensitive credentials are stored using industry-standard hashing and peppering. Secrets are not logged in plain text.

apiKeys.title: API keys and access
apiKeys.body: Create and rotate project API keys from Studio. Keys authenticate SDK and server requests. We recommend separate keys per environment and revoking unused keys promptly.

audit.title: Audit and observability
audit.body: Studio provides usage metrics and chat logs for your projects. Platform operators maintain technical logs for security monitoring, abuse detection, and incident response.

incident.title: Incident reporting
incident.body: If you discover a security vulnerability or suspect unauthorized access, contact security@actocore.pro. We investigate reports promptly and will coordinate disclosure responsibly.

compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.intro: ActoCore supports teams with regulatory and procurement requirements. This page describes our compliance posture at a high level.

gdpr.title: GDPR
gdpr.body: We process personal data as a processor for customer-uploaded content and as a controller for account billing data. We support data subject requests and provide a DPA on request for business customers.

dpa.title: Data Processing Agreement
dpa.body: Business and enterprise customers may request a DPA covering subprocessors, security measures, and breach notification. Contact legal@actocore.pro.

soc2.title: SOC 2
soc2.body: ActoCore maintains a SOC 2 Type II program. Summary reports are available to qualified prospects and customers under NDA.

subprocessors.title: Subprocessor transparency
subprocessors.body: We maintain a list of subprocessors used to deliver the service, including hosting, database, email, payments, and AI model providers. Material changes are communicated to customers.

residency.title: Data residency
residency.body: Production infrastructure is hosted with major cloud providers. Specific residency requirements for enterprise deployments can be discussed with our team.

about.title: The integration layer for product AI
about.subtitle: ActoCore helps teams ship in-app assistants without building RAG, orchestration, and multi-tenant infrastructure from scratch.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.body: Product teams should focus on their users — not on vector databases, prompt pipelines, and billing for LLM usage. ActoCore provides Studio for configuration, Core for reasoning and retrieval, and an embeddable SDK for your React app.

audience.title: Who it's for
audience.body: SaaS companies, internal tools teams, and developers embedding AI chat with knowledge grounding and in-app actions. From first prototype on the Free plan to production scale on Business.

developer.title: Developer-first
developer.body: Clear APIs, a published npm SDK, and docs you can follow in one sitting.

tenant.title: Multi-tenant by default
tenant.body: Isolation, scoped API keys, and per-project knowledge — built in, not bolted on.

production.title: Production-ready
production.body: Streaming chat, citations, action handlers, billing, and observability — not just a demo widget.

fields.appThemesHint: Match what your host app supports. The SDK uses the palette for the active theme.
fields.leaveBlankHint: Leave blank to use the SDK default shown as the placeholder.
fields.copyLauncherHint: Pre-filled with SDK defaults. Only customized values are saved to your project config.
fields.themeColorsBothHint: Configure separate palettes for light and dark. The SDK picks the palette that matches the active theme in your app.
fields.themeColorsLightOnlyHint: Configure brand colors for your app's light theme.
fields.themeColorsDarkOnlyHint: Configure brand colors for your app's dark theme.
fields.themeColorsHint: Leave blank to use SDK defaults for that palette. Pick a swatch or enter a hex code (#RGB or #RRGGBB).
fields.fontFamilyHint: Applied to the chat widget via the font-family design token.
fields.composerRowsHint: Each row must be between 1 and 12. Minimum cannot exceed maximum. SDK defaults: 1 minimum, 6 maximum.
fields.launcherPositionHint: Corner of the screen where the chat launcher appears.
fields.launcherOffsetHint: Distance from the screen edge (e.g. 1.25rem or 20px).

errors.composerRowsInvalid: Composer rows must be whole numbers between 1 and 12.
errors.composerRowsOrder: Minimum composer rows cannot be greater than maximum.
errors.launcherIconUrlInvalid: Launcher icon URL must be a valid http or https URL.
errors.launcherOffsetInvalid: Offsets must be CSS lengths like 1.25rem or 20px.
errors.fieldTooLong: One or more fields exceed the maximum length.
errors.invalidHexColor: Each color must be a valid hex code (#RGB or #RRGGBB) or left empty.
errors.fontFamilyTooLong: Font stack is too long (max 200 characters).
